scientific_question: Can a compact query-conditioned fact from the same rank10 source improve the cost-risk tradeoff of early evidence injection relative to the raw M0B atom?
teacher_role: positive-control generator only; not assumed deployable
hard_validation: source_quote is an exact source substring
fact is nonempty and <=16 Qwen3-8B tokens
all explicit numeric concepts in fact occur in source
all detected named entities in fact occur in source
no gold or Target-outcome fields are loaded
manual_grounding_audit: Blinded SHA-first 32 generated facts; require >=31 supported and zero gold/outcome leakage before SEM-A1
sem_a1_population: 128 train queries selected by SHA before teacher generation and outside M0C/M1/M2B action cohorts where feasible
sem_a1_selection: No selector; fixed generation and insertion rule
sem_a1_primary_comparison: On the same queries, semantic arm versus raw arm across five-level success, Complete repair/break, cumulative context tokens, and compressor compute
sem_a1_gate: At least two of: semantic safe-Complete repairs exceed raw by >=8/128; semantic Complete breaks are <=50% of raw; semantic cumulative context overhead is <=50% of raw. Semantic fixed Complete must not be below V8. Gate authorizes SEM-A2 design only.
